clips.title: The story
paras: In Anvilmar, young Bronzebeard dwarves and displaced gnomes gather to train and prepare for the road ahead. The fortified outpost stands in snowy Coldridge Valley, in Dun Morogh, around a great stone forge.

At Anvilmar, a central forge burns within sturdy stone walls in the northern crags of Coldridge Valley. Class mentors and supply vendors are here, alongside veteran mountain mountaineers who drill recruits before they set out into the wider kingdom. Snowdrifts shelter the outpost, but Frostmane trolls and wild beasts prowl the frozen valley, keeping its defenders on guard.

Anvilmar may take its name from High King Modimus Anvilmar, who ruled the dwarven clans before the War of the Three Hammers. The garrison keeps watch today, tending the forge fires as trolls and beasts roam the valley.
